method: Official Week-10 game status (Out/Doubtful) joined to the same club's own depth chart by normalised player name, then checked at the position-group level. depth_string 1 = first man on the chart at that slot; replacement = next man at the SAME slot; replacement_depth = 2,3,4 tells you how thin the club is. Cross-group and no-backup matches are separated, not counted.
